name: Shortcut
tagline: AI agent for spreadsheets that builds and edits financial models in Excel and Sheets.
description: An AI agent purpose-built for spreadsheet work, from cleaning data and writing formulas to building full financial models — DCFs, LBOs, and three-statement models — from a natural-language prompt. It runs as a web app and as native add-ins for Excel and Google Sheets, with a Windows CLI for power users. Built for analysts who live in spreadsheets rather than as a generic chatbot bolted onto a grid.
insight: From MIT-founded Fundamental Research Labs; in tests it beat first-year McKinsey and Goldman analysts about 89% of the time.
edge: Purpose-built for analysts who live in spreadsheets — it works inside their existing files rather than as a generic chatbot bolted onto a grid.
pros: Native Excel and Google Sheets add-ins

references.title: Is 'Shortcut' the New Excel? MIT Startup Behind Viral AI Tool Thinks So
